proof_scope: Original D420->CC50, E680 mode-0x80 generic, and E680 mode-0x7F->DD70 generic loops on one 319-pixel synthetic row; paired source/LUT inputs, register witnesses, access order, and zero-source skips.

prediction.family: CC50 and E680 packed UV feedback closure
prediction.prediction: On the established 319-pixel row, CC50's 0xD322 loop will advance its UV state through EAX/EBX/ECX and decrement AX for its count, while raw source and palette result stay in DL; neither will change later UV samples. E680 mode 0x80's 0xEE6D loop and E680 mode 0x7F through DD70's 0xE56C loop will advance UV through EAX/EBX/ECX and the corrected ESI texture pointer, decrement AX for the count, and keep raw source, shade and blend bytes in EDX. None will feed the UV state; each loop will reconstruct its per-pixel EDX source/destination lanes. Zero source will still consume one iteration and skip the route's palette or shade/blend/destination/output operations.
prediction.falsifier: A controlled raw-source, CLUT, shade-LUT, or blend-LUT change alters any later UV-carrying register or texture address in one of these bounded routes; the observed earliest register divergence is outside the byte/color lane; the source/LUT/output event order differs from the stated route; a zero source performs a forbidden lookup/read/write; or a route fails to execute exactly 319 row iterations and stop within the pinned original instruction/memory boundaries.

fixture.source_lut_controls: Keep outputs equal across the raw-source pair; vary one selected LUT result in a separate pair. Also run an all-zero texture through each route.

routes: E680 mode 0x7F -> DD70 shade row 0x7F generic

interpretation.cc50: The long-row source address stream is independent of raw texel and palette output in this finite route; palette result affects only the destination byte.
interpretation.e680_mode80: The long-row source address stream is independent of raw texel and blend output in this finite route; blend result affects only the destination byte.
interpretation.e680_shaded_7f: The long-row source address stream is independent of raw texel, shade result, and blend output in this finite route; shade/blend bytes stay on the color path.
interpretation.cross_route_limit: This evidence distinguishes these three routes from the existing D60C AL-feedback witness; it does not generalize to other modes, selectors, shapes, clipping domains, or source/LUT ownership states.

limits: Only one wire-valid clipped 319-pixel row was executed per controlled case.
All tables, texture, stack, and destination bytes are synthetic emulator memory.
No host callback, DirectDraw, GPU, full raster, gameplay, or unsupported mode/selector was executed.
Register equality is limited to the recorded loop landmarks and these paired inputs.
